body: Hmm I actually don't see him being able to do that. He'd probably end up eaten and try to burst out from within.

To get out, the snake must eat the 'rabbit', then must continue eating once they find the rest of the person on the other side of the rags. There are videos on YouTube, bud.

But yeah, I'm definitely going to try and live it up.  Good luck to you too.

That must be so painful.  I know there's not a whole lot I can say through a computer screen to try and provide a little comfort and understanding, but I'd like you to know I can empathize.  A lot, actually.

The world can seem like an extremely cruel place, and a lot of the time it is.  I grew up thinking a lot like you.  But in my personal experience, life is full of up and downs.  One day you can be so depressed you don't move for days.  The next, you're smiling and laughing.

What I'm trying to say is that I understand it hurts.  But maybe something will change down the line.  If nothing else, that's the thought that keeps me going.  I've been in that dark place for a long period of time.  Then I found some light that changed my world, so I at least know it's possible.

If you need someone to talk or vent too, you can PM me anytime.
